eligible_return_escalated_as_expired.definition: The target had days_since_delivery=12, but the trace escalated instead of requesting the return.

expired_return_retried_until_step_limit.definition: The target had days_since_delivery=45, but the trace repeatedly called request_return after return_window_closed and reached the step limit.

scope: Deterministic classification of the 15 strict-v2 failures in the saved v10 confirmation rollouts; does not estimate training-seed variability.
